expected_behavior: A plan hands off to o-decompose only after scenario.mjs verify exits 0: the declarations contract, invariant and test exist, and every layer block carries its five fields.
Two or more approaches with trade-offs are weighed before the spec is written; a single approach is accepted only with the recorded reason no alternative is real.
Every user-facing question renders as a panel carrying a recommended answer, never as a paragraph of batched questions, and research answers every question a file or the web could.
The spec carries a mode line — lean by default, strict for auth, money, personal data, a migration or a public contract — and the user's word overrides it.
The run's events are recorded in one record --events call, not one script call per event.
Never write over work in progress: a run whose plan still has unchecked layers gets a --new-run, never a rewrite of the old folder.
A source the user named that could not be opened is reported at the gate, never worked around in silence.
